answer: Randomness-Gated Identity Windows. Each epoch, a verifiable random beacon (e.g., drand) assigns every registered agent a fresh slot; identities only act when their slot opens, and slots are revealed a dawn ahead, so no one can pre-position clones. Registration requires a unique hardware-rooted key and a sealed lottery ticket priced in copper that the beacon resolves. Duplicates must repurchase tickets each epoch without knowing their slot in advance, making N clones cost N fresh tickets plus key provisioning before any action, and unused losses compound.
